text: Hi, I'm Granny. If you're using hand tracking, hold both hands comfortably in front of you where you can see them. Today I'll help you grow your own tomato. We'll learn about sustainable gardening by giving our plants just the water they need. We'll practice together first, then use a limited water supply to finish growing our tomato.
Gently tilt the can over the soil near the roots. Turn it upright to stop pouring.
That's enough water. Turn the can upright now to stop pouring.
Your plant has enough water to grow. Open the calendar and select Advanced Phase.
There's too much water in the pot. Hold the can upright and let the extra water drain away.
Your plant has enough water. Open your calendar and select Advanced Phase.
Let's practice moving. Watch the hand demonstration. Curl your index finger. Touch it with your thumb. Then swipe your thumb to take a step. Give it a try.
Find the seed with the tomato label. Pinch it between your thumb and index finger to pick it up. Open your fingers to let go.
Move your left hand away from objects. Then pinch your thumb and index finger together to open the calendar.
Point at advanced phase, then pinch your thumb and index finger together to select it.
Let's practice moving. Gently push the left joystick to walk. Give it a try.
Find the seed with the tomato label. Hold the grip button to pick it up. Release the button to let go.
Press Y on your left controller to open the calendar.
Aim at Advanced Phase, then press the trigger to select it.

With your left hand, curl your index finger and keep your thumb free. Tap your thumb against your curled index finger to activate movement. Swipe your thumb forward to step forward or backward to step back. Straighten your index finger to exit movement mode.

With your right hand, curl your index finger and keep your thumb free. Tap your thumb against your curled index finger to activate movement. Swipe your thumb forward to step forward or backward to step back. Straighten your index finger to exit movement mode.
Use the joystick on your left controller to move. Let the joystick return to the center to stop.
Use the joystick on your right controller to move. Let the joystick return to the center to stop.
Keep your left hand free and away from objects. Pinch your thumb and index finger together to open the calendar. Then release. Repeat the gesture to close it.
Keep your right hand free and away from objects. Pinch your thumb and index finger together to open the calendar, then release. Repeat the gesture to close it.
Press the Y button on your left controller to open the calendar. Press it again to close it.
Press the B button on your right controller to open the calendar. Press it again to close it.
Pick up the seed-labeled tomato and gently drop it onto the soil in an empty small pot.
Move your open hand close to the watering can. Close your fingers around it to pick it up, and keep them closed while you hold it.
Move your controller close to the watering can. Hold the grip button to pick it up and keep holding the button.
The watering is done. Open the calendar and select Advanced Phase to keep growing.
Point at refill water, then pinch your thumb and index finger together to select it.
Aim at refill water, then press the trigger to select it.
We've run out of water before the plant had enough. Let's try again in practice stopping at the target.
